sources.snippet: We introduce MagicLens, a series of self-supervised image retrieval models that support open-ended instructions. The core thesis of MagicLens is that text instructions can enable retrieving images with richer relations beyond visual similarity. sources.snippet: We present MagicLens: a series of image retrieval models. Trained on 36.7M (query image, instruction, target image) triplets with rich semantic relations mined from the web, a single MagicLens model can achieve comparable or better results on 10 benchmarks of various multimodality-to-image, image-to-image, and text-to-image retrieval tasks than prior state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods.
